Hadith.990 - In the narration of Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamza said:
"The Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
'If a man is one who forgets or becomes distracted in every third part of his prayer, then he is among those for whom distractions are frequent.'"
